html:
FAQ

Frequently asked questions

  • Conare is invite-only for now. Book a demo: we set up your organization with you, and your team then creates API keys in the console.

  • The platform when you want Conare to hold your data, keep it in sync and return the right context. The models or the vector database alone when you already run the rest of the stack.

  • No. We do not train models on your content, unless your organization asks us in writing for a custom model built from it, which then serves your organization alone.

  • On Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud in the United States. Every vendor that processes customer data is on our subprocessors page.

  • A changed record replaces its old version. A deleted one is deleted.
